candidate_criterion: P_PLACO < 1e-8 from a pair-level QC-PASS collation; the threshold is 5e-8 Bonferroni-adjusted across the five selected tracks

clumping.algorithm: greedy lead-variant clumping ordered by P_PLACO, then chromosome, position, and SNP ID
clumping.ld_metric: squared Pearson correlation from the pinned LAVA .bcor/.info reference

missing_reference_variant_policy: Retain in candidate-variant audit as NOT_CLUMPED_NO_EXACT_REFERENCE_MATCH; do not call independent
partial_family_policy: Candidate outputs must be labelled PARTIAL_FAMILY until all four v3 pair collations and protected Track B inputs are validated
coordinate_policy: Require exact CHR/BP agreement with the locked reference; the build label is not inferred from rsID alone
evidence_boundary: PLACO candidate loci only; not evidence of local rg, causal variants, shared causal signals, genes, or mechanisms
